_about: Limits enforced by `scripts/perf_check.py --check` (the perf job in .github/workflows/tests.yml). Sizes are bytes on the wire (gzip), times are milliseconds on a cold load with no CPU throttle on a GitHub-hosted runner (set 2026-10 from a measured 0.8 s LCP / 150 ms TBT on a laptop, about three times looser). Tighten them when the numbers fall; raise one only with a reason in the commit. Standalone file_bytes 27.0 -> 27.4 MB (2026-10): the file now keeps each photo's saved path (+0.15 MB) so its photos come from the published copy instead of the listing sites' links.
